You generally don't need to book a taxi, but if you arrive late at night, travel as a large group, or prefer booking via LINE, phone or email (Japanese and Korean), a pre-booked transfer gives you more peace of mind.

Kuma Travel's Gimpo Airport transfer is a flat KRW 80,000 to anywhere in Seoul (Staria, up to 6 passengers, 1 vehicle). The price stays the same late at night, early in the morning and in traffic, and round-trip bookings get 10% off.
Your driver waits at the arrivals hall exit holding a sign with your name. We track your flight, so there is no extra charge for delays.

gmp-seoul-station-taxi.lead: Taxi fares from Gimpo Airport to Seoul Station vary a lot with time of day and traffic. We compare typical metered fares with a flat-rate transfer to Seoul Station hotels, including those connected to the station.
box: KRW 80,000 (1 vehicle, flat rate), same price late at night and early morning
secs: Typical taxi fare from Gimpo Airport to Seoul Station

Measured to Seoul Station, the road distance from the International Terminal is 20.8 km. The route from Gimpo Airport to Seoul Station is mostly on city streets, so the taxi fare is far lower than from Incheon Airport. A regular taxi to Seoul Station typically shows around KRW 21,000–27,000 on the meter (estimated from fares as of November 2026 and road distance).

A late-night surcharge (20–40% depending on the hour) applies from 22:00–4:00. Roads at Seoul Station are split between the front and back of the station, so the pickup and drop-off point depends on which side your hotel is on.

Kuma Travel's transfer is a flat KRW 80,000, unchanged late at night, early in the morning or in traffic. 4 people sharing 1 car pay KRW 20,000 each, which can work out cheaper than splitting into 2 taxis.
Regular taxi vs. flat-rate transfer
At Gimpo Airport, watch out for unlicensed touts approaching you in the arrivals hall. Only take a taxi from the official stand, and show the driver your Seoul Station hotel name in Korean.

At Gimpo Airport the taxi stand is close to the arrivals hall, and waits are fairly short. With a transfer, we meet you at the arrivals hall exit and take you straight to the car. Roads at Seoul Station are split between the front and back of the station, so the pickup and drop-off point depends on which side your hotel is on.
When a transfer makes sense

Late arrival：The front of the station is well lit at night, but the back alleys are dark, so stick to the main roads. A transfer lets you travel without worrying about the taxi late-night surcharge (20–40%).
Lots of luggage：Roads at Seoul Station are split between the front and back of the station, so the pickup and drop-off point depends on which side your hotel is on.

First visit：Many people stay here before or after taking the KTX to Busan and other cities, and the elevated Seoullo 7017 walkway makes a nice stroll. With no tiring journey, you can start sightseeing the day you arrive.
Solo, few bags：The AREX airport railroad goes to Seoul Station with no changes in about 20 min. To keep costs down, the train is best.

The terminus of the AREX airport railroad and a KTX hub, with a Lotte Mart and hotels connected to the station. Major hotels include those connected to the station and business hotels on the Namdaemun side. If your group is split across several hotels around Seoul Station, we can drop you off one by one.

gmp-yeouido-ikikata.lead: On your first trip to Korea and unsure how to get from Gimpo Airport to Yeouido? Take the train to save money or a transfer for comfort. Here are travel times and tips for heading to the area around The Hyundai Seoul in Yeouido.
box: KRW 80,000 (1 vehicle, flat rate), same price late at night and early morning
secs: 4 ways to get from Gimpo Airport to Yeouido
Train (direct)：Take a Subway Line 9 express or Line 5 to Yeouido Station with no changes.

Limousine bus：Airport limousine buses do run, but since the city is close, most people at this airport take the subway or a taxi. Take a Subway Line 9 express or Line 5 to Yeouido Station with no changes.
Taxi：Catch one at the stand right outside the arrivals hall. Expect around KRW 17,000–21,000 (estimated from fares as of November 2026, late-night surcharge extra).

Private pickup：No changes from the arrivals hall exit to your hotel entrance, for a flat KRW 80,000 (1 vehicle). Yeouido, home to the National Assembly and the financial district, gets congested at commuting times, so allow extra time on weekday mornings and evenings.
How to choose
Late or early：During the spring cherry blossom season, roads stay busy into weekend nights. A transfer waits for your flight and costs the same as during the day.
Lots of luggage：Yeouido, home to the National Assembly and the financial district, gets congested at commuting times, so allow extra time on weekday mornings and evenings.
First visit：Shop at The Hyundai Seoul, then enjoy the night views at Yeouido Hangang Park. With no tiring journey, you can start sightseeing the day you arrive.
Solo, few bags：Take a Subway Line 9 express or Line 5 to Yeouido Station with no changes. To keep costs down, the train is best.

An island in the Han River with the National Assembly, the financial district and Hangang Park. The Hyundai Seoul is also popular. Highlights include The Hyundai Seoul, Yeouido Hangang Park and the 63 Building. Nearby areas are Yeongdeungpo (about 1.6 km), Hongdae (about 4.0 km) and Yongsan (about 3.7 km).
